title: Can’t speak more highly
content: This is such a great app for documenting your travels on. I recently went on a two month journey across the world and it was such a great way of remembering the trip, tracking where I was and how far we had been each day. I also ordered the photo album for the trip at the end of it, which is pristine and an amazing keepsake. Will be continuing to use this app in the future and will order many more photos books. Thanks for the great work.
author: Jamiedcmje

title: Great idea.. poor execution.
content:
Although the premise behind this app is fantastic, the technology and their programming are not yet up to delivering upon the idea.

Having used it on a long trip of over 10 months the app constantly struggles to store location data and fails to pick up on locational changes across multiple countries. 

More annoyingly, it’s recently started to just forget (or delete) the content I have submitted or uploaded and then started incorrectly tracking my location over these previous stops.

Not only is this painstaking to fix, it just underlines how much more work is needed to get this app at the level required for sustained use. I’ve used multiple GPS systems across phones, Garmin watches etc to try and achieve similar effects. I have even used this app across multiple phones - therefore ruling out a hardware error.

Bottom line: this is decent for a week’s vacation or less. Any further and it’s mileage will 100% vary.
author: HSS-2023

title: Amazing App to keep connected
content: This is a great way to keep connected. Whether I use it or I follow family and friends. Keeping a journal and adding photos which can then be created into a keepsake album really makes this special. It’s also a great way to keep track on where people are day to day. Whether this is used for a short two week adventure or a long gap year adventure it is a MUST have for anyone. 🌍
author: Stolford

title: Love Polarsteps
content: Our daughter used Polarsteps for her year of travelling so I said I’d use it too for our big trip. It’s been wonderful to write about where we’ve been each day and review the photos, which often you don’t do until weeks after you get home. Also, it’s been a great aid memoir as we’ve done so much that sometimes you forget where we’ve been and this brings back great memories. Thanks Polarsteps.
author: Polarpassion

author: Beema Man

title: Great way to record and share your trip

author: Petit Plus

Recommend

Jason

author: Emi_ D

Absolutely love this app.

author: D&MK

author: Xxtattzxxx

author: woo woo29

author: Bouwouw

author: Mum of travelling son

author: Gadget Phil

author: 164!!Kd

title: Ryan & Georgie’s

author: gowen10

title: Memory Picture Book

App also has ‘Guides’ for lots of key destinations with activity suggestions. 

Will use Polarsteps for all future trips

author: The130camper

title: Great, but then it deleted everything!
content:
This app was fantastic and has been tracking our journey for our 9 month trip around New Zealand. As we are often off the beaten track I cannot always connect to the internet, so the offline mode worked great.

Until it deleted everything I had not yet published when the app crashed! I spent hours and hours trying to retrace our footsteps until I had it all back, only for it to crash again during the upload and delete everything again! 

Only one month left of our trip and now the app doesn’t seem usable! I managed to keep up blogging for 8 months, only to never have a complete log of our journey because of this app!

Devastated! Hundreds of hours of work lost!

title: Travel sharing
content:
Perfect.

Really easy to download and follow people!
I highly recommend this to anyone who is planning on travelling.

Thank you to the developers from myself and my family/ friends. :)

title: Beware - A total con
content:
All this app will do is harvest all of your data, and do nothing with it.  I’ve had the app for two weeks of travelling, and it has recorded absolutely nothing (yes, I’ve set location to always on etc.).

There is nothing automatic about this app, you have to do everything manually.  Plot dates, routes, add photos etc.  Which makes the whole thing pointless.  Likely just making money selling your photos/location data, amongst other things.  Beware, this app is not what it says it is.
